messages:
Ravi: Heads-up: customer support flagged invoice-preview vs final invoice mismatch ~+9% for tenant `brightdata`. Spotty hours 03:10-03:50 UTC.
Naomi: :thinking: any recent changes to quota or routing?
Ravi: We rolled a routing policy tweak last night to prefer low-latency edge for small requests (<=64 tokens). Might have affected meter sampling.
Luca: If small requests were re-routed to a different proxy, their client-id header might have been rewritten -> attribution drift.
Tara: MetricsBot shows a heartbeat gap on quota-service between 03:12-03:18 UTC. Could be related.
MetricsBot: quota-service heartbeat missed 6/6 pings 2026-03-24T03:12:00Z -> 2026-03-24T03:18:00Z. Trace: kube-pod-restart in cluster eu-west-1.
Owen: So two things: edge routing change + quota heartbeat gap = some requests may have been counted against fallback quota or dropped into soft-fail path. Preview pipeline may be ingesting raw tokens while tally service applied quota-induced drop.
Naomi: Can we run a quick join: ```SELECT hour, SUM(preview_tokens) as p, SUM(tally_tokens) as t FROM previews p JOIN tallies t USING (hour, tenant) WHERE tenant='brightdata' AND hour BETWEEN '2026-03-24 02:00' AND '2026-03-24 05:00' GROUP BY hour;```
Ravi: Ran it. 03:00 hour delta +11% concentrated 03:10-03:30.
Luca: Check headers: ```SELECT request_id, headers->'x-client-id' AS client, headers->'x-route' AS route FROM raw_events WHERE hour='2026-03-24 03:15' LIMIT 50;```
Tara: Sample shows ~22% of those rows have missing x-client-id or x-route set to `edge-fallback`.
Owen: tally-service dedupe path expects client-id for attribution. Missing -> records treated as ephemeral and dropped in final tally. Previews currently write before quota/dedup stage so they include those tokens.
Naomi: Root cause: routing change + quota-service restart caused header rewrite/drops.
Ravi: Immediate mitigation: pause invoice-preview send for affected tenants and hours. Add console banner: "Invoice previews may be overstated for 2026-03-24 03:10-03:30 UTC due to routing/heartbeat drift."
Luca: Also flip routing change to canary until we harden header propagation. I'll open rollback PR for routing-policy.
Tara: I'll restart quota-service and check heartbeat recovery; add pod anti-affinity to avoid co-locating with edge proxies.
Owen: Reconciliation plan: re-run preview rows for affected window using post-quota normalized events (i.e., after dedupe and quota filters) so preview matches final tallies. Short job: join raw_events -> quota_decisions -> write corrected preview_tokens.
Naomi: Add dashboard panel: "preview/tally token gap by tenant" and an alert when gap > 5% for 10m.
Ravi: Also add CI gating: any deploy that touches routing headers must run a header-propagation parity check between preview-writer and tally-ingest (sample 10k requests).
Luca: I'll include header propagation integration tests in the routing repo.
Tara: Infra note: quota-service pods restarted at 03:11 due to OOM; increasing mem request and enabling vertical autoscaler for that deployment.
MetricsBot: Incident created: INC-2026-338 assigned to Luca/Tara/Ravi.
Owen: Short-term steps summary: 1) pause preview-sends for affected tenants, 2) rollback routing-policy canary, 3) restart quota-service & patch, 4) run reconcile job, 5) add dashboard+alert.
Ravi: I'll post the preview pause flag and add the console banner. Will update incident with reconcile ETA.
